## RE:volution Mod v2.12.0

### Added

- Added the permanent Mechanic Unlock System driven by historical Standard Rune progression by rarity.
- Added the server-authoritative Mechanic Unlock journal with locked, ready-to-unlock and unlocked states, manual Unlock actions and a ready-state tab highlight.
- Added Balance Core definitions for Arts / Mastery, Run Exchange, God Worship, Aura System, Achievements, Unique Rune Collections and configured God child mechanics.
- Added parent/child unlock visibility, persistent Mongo state, admin force-unlock/force-lock controls and debug progress inspection.

### Fixed

- Prevented reset, rollback and re-obtain flows from farming mechanic unlock progress by storing monotonic historical rune maxima instead of event counters.
- Prevented locked mechanics from being used through direct packets, hotkeys, commands or passive modifier paths while preserving their persistent gameplay data.
- Kept Achievement factual background tracking intact while player-facing Achievement access remains locked.
- Added replay protection for manual unlock intents and server-authored eligibility/visibility snapshots.

### Other

- Only Standard Rune Collections contribute to mechanic unlock progression; Unique Rune Collections do not contribute.
- Unlock requirements are non-spendable thresholds and remain ZBT Draft values controlled by Balance Core.
- Unlocking remains explicit and manual: reaching a requirement makes an entry eligible but never auto-unlocks it.

### Download

Download `RE-volution-2.12.0.jar` from the assets attached to this GitHub Release.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v2.11.0...v2.12.0
